title: Can Demographic Factors Improve Text Classification? Revisiting Demographic Adaptation in the Age of Transformers

bias_targets.methodology: Specializing pretrained language models via dynamic multi-task learning (coupling masked language modeling with gender category prediction) on gender-annotated review data, followed by evaluating the impact on intrinsic demographic classification and extrinsic downstream text classification tasks (sentiment analysis and topic detection), as well as visualizing the representation space using t-SNE.

Applying demographic specialization through multi-task learning on age-annotated corpora (users under 35 vs. over 45), evaluating the performance differences on downstream text classification and intrinsic age prediction tasks, and conducting meta-regression and t-SNE qualitative analysis to isolate the effects of age-related language variations.
